notes.title: The lifting of restrictions on access to five types of weapons.
notes.content: Now, right after the first level, you have access to rockets, a plasma gun, mines, homing shells, and a laser gun. Of course, you may not have enough money to fully load up at the beginning, but at least you have the freedom to choose. And that's what humanity is constantly fighting so hard for!

notes.title: Optimizing everything bit by bit
notes.content: I optimized the game during the porting process to consoles by improving textures, particles, and game code. This reduced the load on processors and video cards without compromising image quality. While I didn't receive any complaints, I decided to release an updated PC version though.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.2
notes.content:
At your request, keyboard controls have been improved. Now there is no slowdown and inertia when controlling the player using the keyboard.
If anyone liked the old controls better, let me know, and I'll give you the option to choose between the old and new controls.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
EDITED: I added the ability to choose between the old control and the new one.
Now in the SETTINGS you can enable or disable "Inertia" (it is enabled by default)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A small change on the second level makes it more comfortable to pass in the area of structures that are dangerous for collision.

Some changes in the interface of the store (hangar), are aimed at understanding the gameplay.

Replaced the icon with a new one, courtesy of Bob Mandel.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.1
notes.content:
NEW: Added D-Pad support
FIXES: Highlighted selected main menu buttons

notes.title: Vostok 2061 is released!
notes.content:
Today I release my first-ever game. I spent over five years creating Vostok 2061 in my spare time. 
Initially, I expected it took several months. I thought I would do something very simple since my programming skills were at zero. I won’t say that I did something difficult, but as a result, over time, I added to the game something that I never thought I could be able.

I hope people like it.

notes.title: Wanted Evil alien fish!
notes.content:
Hey! Adding achievements to the game allows you not only to diversify the gameplay, but in fact add another game to the existing one.

So, I'm happy to introduce you the Evil alien fish, a very rare creature that can float right in space. It usually avoids open spaces and tries to stay out of sight. This fish does not bring benefits, and sometimes it can do harm. Therefore, your task is to find and shoot 8 evil alien fish in the game. Those who do this will receive the achievement "Thanks Ror All the Fish"! 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39099234/824113fb66017e358c61fe94f1583de688e3385e.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoy this as much as I did when I added this evil alien fish to the game. ːsteamhappyː

PS I do not publish screenshots of the fish, as its location on the levels is a secret .
